parsedVerdict.reasoning: This file is an infrastructure persistence adapter. It implements the domain port SubscriptionRepository with an in-memory Map, and every method is storage work: byId looks up a record, save stores one, nextId generates identifiers for this store, and activeFor runs a query. The filter in activeFor (customerId match and state === 'active') is how the repository answers the query the port names. It is not a domain rule, because nothing in it decides or changes what state a subscription is in. No domain rules, application orchestration or presentation logic are in the file.
